# T22d — Hero light aircraft (Cessna 172 class) generated by the Blender script

Tools track · Depends on T22a's generator and T22c's audit tool · Branch `task/t22d-cessna`, based
on `task/t22a-sample-models` @ `aec1269` · Opus 5.5 session with Blender MCP + script (the T22a
"Plan update — 2026-10-12 late" workflow) · Started 2026-10-14 at the user's request.

## User decisions (2026-10-14)
- **Hero / ownship tier** (same as the Hawk): exterior ≤ 100 k triangles, cockpit ≤ 150 k,
  total cap 250 k, `.glb` ≤ 10 MB (soft). The cap is a ceiling, not a target: the audit decides
  whether triangles are earned.
- Modelled on the **Cessna 172 Skyhawk** (172R/S): public dimensions only, no markings or logos.
  Credit: "generic high-wing light aircraft, not affiliated". File `cessna.glb`.
- Run in **this session** (Opus, Blender MCP for the live loop, `tools/models/*.py` the single
  source of truth). The audit gates are approved by the user **before** the full build; STOP with
  images + audit report at every checkpoint; independent Opus review before any merge.

## Published figures (check E, ±2 %)
| | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Length | 8.28 m (27 ft 2 in) | [Wikipedia, Cessna 172 — Specifications (172R)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cessna_172), accessed 2026-10-14 |
| Span | 11.00 m (36 ft 1 in) | same |
| Height | 2.72 m (8 ft 11 in) | same |
| Wing area | 16.2 m², modified NACA 2412 | same |
| Propeller | 2 blades, fixed pitch, 1.91 m diameter | same |
| Wing root / tip chord | ≈ 1.63 m (64 in) / ≈ 1.13 m (44.5 in) | [Cessna 172 design study (Jane's 1977-78 data)](https://pdfcoffee.com/cessna-172-design-pdf-free.html), accessed 2026-10-14 — secondary source, shape only |
| Dihedral | ≈ 1.7° | same — secondary |
| Tailplane span | ≈ 3.45 m (11 ft 4 in) | same — secondary (another source says 3.28 m) |

Only length, span and height are gated. The secondary figures set proportions and are not checked.

## Nodes (Blender frame as `hawk.py`: nose −Y, up +Z, metres, origin ≈ CG, left = +X)
| Node | Pivot / use (CIGI ICD 4.1.6 articulated parts) |
|---|---|
| `fuselage` | root: cabin, cowling, tailcone, fin, tailplane, wing struts, steps |
| `wing_l`, `wing_r` | static child nodes (they keep each primitive under raylib's 65 536-vertex limit) |
| `aileron_l`, `aileron_r` | hinge along X → part pitch |
| `flap_l`, `flap_r` | single-slotted flaps, hinge along X → part pitch (0–30°) |
| `elevator` | one piece with trim tab, hinge along X → part pitch |
| `rudder` | hinge along Z → part yaw |
| `propeller` | blades + spinner, pivot on the thrust line → part roll (spinning) |
| `prop_disc` | translucent blur disc, a visibility component (shown when spinning fast) |
| `door_l`, `door_r` | cabin doors, hinge at the front edge (vertical axis) → part yaw |
| `gear` | fixed tricycle gear: spring-steel legs, wheel fairings, nose strut. Static node, kept as a visibility component for consistency with the jet |
| `cockpit` (+ `cockpit_panel` if needed for the vertex limit) | interior: floor, four seats, panel with six-pack + radio stack, two yokes, rudder pedals, throttle/mixture, trim wheel, door trims, headliner |
| `eyepoint_left`, `eyepoint_right` | empties at the pilot (left seat) and right-seat eye height |

About 18 nodes (budget 24). Materials from `mm_common.MATERIALS` (paint, glass, dark, metal,
light); no HUD.

## Fidelity (follows research 03 Addendum A, hero tier)
Exterior: smooth lofted fuselage with the cowling, cowl inlets and exhaust stacks, the
windscreen, side and rear (Omni-Vision) windows as glass, wing with NACA 2412-like section, the
constant-chord inner panel and tapered outer panel, washout, dihedral, wing-tip fairings,
lift struts with fairings, fuel caps, stall-warning vent, pitot; tailplane, fin with dorsal
fin; spring-steel main gear and nose oleo with wheel fairings; panel lines, rivets as one-triangle
dots, nav/beacon/strobe lights; baked vertex AO; per-vertex colour (white with a simple
two-tone cheat line, generic, no registration or logos).
Cockpit: as in the node table; legible gauge faces come later with textures (T22b), now dark
dials with light needles as geometry.

## Checks
- **Audit** (`scripts/audit_models.sh --name cessna`, gates in `tools/models/audit/cessna.toml`):
  the T22c method unchanged. Gates are proposed in that file and set by the user at STOP 0.
- **Generator checks** added to `make_models.py` for this model: node names; left/right sides;
  bounding box ±4 % (the audit's ±2 % is the real gate); no floating islands; the three tyres
  touch the ground plane within 5 mm at rest; propeller tip ground clearance ≥ 0.20 m (the
  real aircraft has about 0.29 m); the propeller pivot lies on the spinner axis.
- `detail_check.py` (detail 1 vs 4: shape unchanged) and determinism (two headless builds give
  byte-identical `.glb` and PNGs).

## Checkpoints (images + audit report at each; STOP for review)
- **STOP 0 — plan and gates (this brief + `cessna.toml`).** The user approves or amends.
- **CP1 — exterior blockout:** the main lofts at final proportions (fuselage, wing, tail,
  struts, gear, prop, glass areas), moving parts as nodes with pivots; size check, the
  standard views, `--fast` audit. Purpose: agree proportions before detail.
- **CP2a — detailed exterior:** everything in the exterior list above; full audit.
- **CP2b — cockpit:** interior; views from `eyepoint_left` and `eyepoint_right`, a doors-open
  view and a view through the windscreen; full audit with the cockpit group required.
- **CP3 — wrap-up:** LOD1/2/3 files (≈ 4 k / 1 k / 200 triangles, names and pivots kept, LOD3
  may be static); detail check; determinism; `databases/sample/models/CREDITS.md` entry; size and
  triangle table; STATUS/README update. Then the independent Opus review and the merge.

## Boundaries
- Do not change `hawk.py` (the T22a session owns it and has uncommitted work in its worktree).
  `mm_common.py`: additions only, no behaviour changes for existing helpers (avoids merge
  conflicts with T22a); Cessna-only helpers live in `tools/models/cessna.py`.
- `make_models.py`: register the model, its checks and preview framing per model.
- No downloads or installs, no `.blend` committed, nothing exported from the live MCP session,
  no `database.toml` (needs T20), no C++ changes. PNG previews ≤ 300 KB each; commit the `.glb`
  and previews only at checkpoints.
- Merge order: this branch depends on T22a; it merges after T22a reaches `main` (or into the
  T22a branch if the user prefers).

## Checkpoint log

**2026-10-14 — STOP 0 approved.** The user accepted the plan and every proposed gate unchanged,
and asked that the branch be pushed to GitHub after every checkpoint. Later the same day the
user went away for about an hour: checkpoints run unattended (commit + push, no stop), ending
with a PR whose description shows images of the aircraft.

**2026-10-14 — CP1 (exterior blockout).** `tools/models/cessna.py` + registration in
`make_models.py` (model table, per-model preview framing and checks; `view_layer.update()`
before the size check so parented parts are measured in place — the jet's numbers do not
change). `cessna.glb`: 22 617 triangles, 0.624 vertices per triangle, 649 KB, 14 nodes,
25 primitives (largest 6 318 vertices). Size 8.28 × 11.01 × 2.72 m. Propeller ground
clearance 0.275 m; all three tyres on the ground. `detail_check.py --only cessna` PASS (every
detail-1 vertex on the detail-4 surface). Two headless builds byte-identical (`.glb` and all
9 PNGs).
- Construction: fuselage skin = one loft of a two-exponent superellipse section (upper and
  lower halves, widest line at its own height) with **curvature-adaptive stations** in both
  directions (chordal target 0.4 mm at detail 1, longest edge 0.30 m); doors, windows, the
  windscreen, the rear window, the cheat line and the roof cut-out are station knots, so
  materials and colours change on vertex rings. Wings: NACA 2412 with washout and dihedral
  (`foil_loft`, copied from hawk.py so the two models stay independent), flaps hinged below
  the wing (offset pivot) and ailerons; tailplane and fin roots follow the tail-cone skin;
  doors are hinged at the front edge, double-skinned with window reveals; propeller node with
  spinner and two twisted blades; `prop_disc` translucent; closed wheel fairings with only the
  visible arc of each tyre.
- Audit (`--fast`, `docs/guide/img/models/audit/cessna/cp1_cessna_audit.md`): 76 of 89 gates
  pass, 12 fail, 1 hard (5 flipped: near-zero-area slivers at a rib end, the spinner and a
  control-surface corner). Shape p99 2.42 mm (gate 1), shading p95 2.55° (2°), fuselage
  headroom 20 % (15 %), hidden fuselage 2.14 % / gear 3.67 % (2 %), slivers 5.6 % (1 %),
  belly kink 2.19° (2°). Fixed on the way: 294 → 5 flipped (chord-based orientation of foil
  skins, fairing orientation, rear cabin bulkhead closing the view down the tail cone through
  the windows), detail-dependent skips removed (they broke the reference).
- Next, CP2a: tessellation of wings, struts, doors, propeller and fairings to the shape and
  shading gates; slivers (poles, the fan caps of the tips and the nose bowl); dorsal fin,
  rounded fin and rudder tops, cowl inlets and exhaust, window frames, wing-root fairings,
  lights, antennas, steps, panel lines.

**2026-10-14 — CP2a (detailed exterior).** `cessna.glb` 30 519 triangles, 0.632 vertices per
triangle, 0.90 MB, 14 nodes, 29 primitives (largest 6 875 vertices). detail_check PASS; two
headless builds byte-identical (`.glb` and all 9 PNGs).
- Full audit (`docs/guide/img/models/audit/cessna/cp2a_cessna_audit.md`, 43 s): **87 of 93
  gates pass, no hard failure.** Shape p99 0.99 mm / max 1.96 mm (gates 1 / 4), reverse p99
  0.76 / max 2.45 mm; shading p95 1.63° (2°); every profile gate (belly kink 1.80°, tail cone
  1.45°, cowl to windscreen: no dips or steps).
- Still failing (soft): shading **max** 90° (hard-edged parts whose reference normals differ
  at the crease: door edge walls, hinge faces, tip closing bands), fuselage skin headroom 30 %
  (15 %: a structured grid cannot match an optimal decimation everywhere), hidden fuselage
  2.27 % and gear 2.30 % (2 %: the nose bowl under the inlets, tail cone under the fin and
  tailplane roots, the wheels' hub discs), slivers 1.68 % (1 %: the closing bands of the
  elliptic tips, the dorsal fin's front point, strut and spinner poles).
- Method changes (all deterministic, shape independent of `--detail`):
  - fuselage: **per-ring** curvature-adaptive stations on a fine grid warped to the
    superellipse's crowded flat sides; rings with different counts are zipped between knots
    (so windows, doors and the cheat line stay exact); zipped end caps (no fans);
  - foils: chord stations from the aerofoil's curvature with a minimum leading-edge step
    (sliver control) and fixed counts per loft; elliptic tips closing to a line, flat-shaded
    last band; tailplane, fin roots placed where the surface meets the skin (bisection);
  - wheel fairings: curvature-adaptive arc and lengthwise stations (t = u² nose); tyres only
    where they show, with hub discs; streamlined struts; firewall and rear bulkheads.
- Added: dorsal fin, cowl inlets seated on the nose bowl, exhaust, beacon, strobes, landing
  light, pitot, fuel caps, VHF and belly antennas, door handles, tail tie-down.
